verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is a local AI assistant with agents, so a real command-execution and file-editing surface is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only gives titles for Custom Agent Skills, Agent Flows, MCP compatibility and web scraping. None of these documents shell command execution or local file editing by the agent. Extensibility might allow building such tools, but the pack shows no shipped exec or file-edit capability.
